scope: bounded live proof: each Render staging identity assumes exactly its intended AWS IAM role via OIDC

method.description: Both services resumed, redeployed to commit ed631ae carrying a startup-time AWS STS GetCallerIdentity check that prints its result to the ordinary application log stream, verified there, then re-suspended. No DynamoDB call, no root key generation, no --execute, no provider dispatch.
method.reason_for_this_route: One-off render-cli jobs completed successfully but their stdout was not retrievable through either the render-cli logs command or the Render dashboard's Jobs log panel (both stuck/empty) at the time of this proof; a startup-time print to the already-reliable application log stream was used instead.
method.prior_attempt_note: A first deploy (commit ec45d64) logged via logging.getLogger(...), which uvicorn does not attach a handler to and which was confirmed to produce no output; superseded by ed631ae which prints directly.

results.cross_contamination_check: each service's assumed-role ARN names only its own role; neither observed ARN names the other service's role

post_proof_state: both services confirmed suspended again after this evidence was captured (state re-checked via render-cli: suspended, suspenders=["user"])
